# Outpost product improvements

<!-- Generated by scripts/qa-reports.py; evidence=2026-10-29T13:58:19.357Z; inputs=8151ec1dd1d8dd03a97311581755a977346fbc3db44edfe98bdc91a68cb6c635 -->

Prioritized acceptance work lives in [PROJECT_PLAN.md](PROJECT_PLAN.md); external release blockers live in [RELEASE_READINESS.md](RELEASE_READINESS.md). This document records improvement themes without a second competing status list.

- Expand permitted, patch-reviewed equipment/ability/recipe coverage while retaining explicit unknowns. A recent download or a passing accounting fixture does not establish game correctness.
- Preserve the tested build/composition/guild/favorite flows. Extend full templates, equipment sets, configurable roles, archives and source-backed costs with independent authorization/revision tests.
- Keep numeric assumptions and observation freshness visible. Extend source/city/focus models only when provenance is reviewed; keep manual accounting usable.
- Complete mutation draft/retry recovery beyond settings and favorites; extract remaining page-level database reads without changing behavior.
- Continue per-page measured reference review, genuine permitted media replacement, physical-device and screen-reader sessions. Functional tests and generated artwork do not establish visual acceptance.
- Measure current routes and staging load before performance claims. Retain bounded caches and verify cross-instance/source-failure behavior under controlled conditions.

[Current defects](BUG_TRACKER.md), [calculator scope](docs/engineering/CALCULATOR_PARITY.md) and [visual reviews](docs/design-review/README.md) supply the detailed evidence.
